brief:
An Israeli soldier visiting India has been accused of war crimes related to the demolition of civilian property in Gaza's Khan Younis, according to Middle East Eye. The Hind Rajab Foundation filed a complaint against the soldier, who remained in Indian territory at the time the case was brought.

The foundation's action centers on alleged destruction of homes and civilian infrastructure during military operations in Khan Younis, one of Gaza's most densely populated cities. The complaint represents the second case the Hind Rajab Foundation has filed in India against an Israeli soldier over conduct in Gaza.

title: Hind Rajab Foundation accuses Israeli soldier of war crimes in India
